name: starting architecture
last_analysis:
All nine trials scored 0 on both seeds, and none had any exact build during training. Recipe changes (1 or 2 epochs, smaller batches, higher entropy, longer horizon) did not change this. Neither did head rearrangements meant to fix a possible action-layout mismatch, a transformer trunk, or a column MLP. So the evidence cannot rank anything yet, and the next step is a structural guess.

Two bottlenecks are plausible. First, DONE: an exact build only counts if the agent chooses DONE at exactly the right step. In a flat softmax over about 257 actions, DONE starts near 0.4% and gets crowded out as placement logits sharpen, so the +1 bonus may never be found. Second, landing-layer perception: a good placement needs 'the highest build cell under the footprint is z, and the target is missing at layer z in every footprint cell'. These are per-layer comparisons that 2D trunks blur.

This round therefore tests a separate stop/continue head (on the baseline and on a new per-layer network) and the per-layer network on its own.
